decisions.reason: As a 2018 flagship closely tied to the firm’s strategic direction and core track-lighting system, it is likely to stay unless it clearly falls below aspirations, and the growing industry suggests enough slack to continue it.

This LED luminaire line is close to the established offer, so in a growing premium lighting market the firm would likely keep it absent strong evidence of underperformance relative to its aspirations.

The home automation server box is somewhat less central and more uncertain than the lighting products, so if its results have been ambiguous the firm would be more likely to reallocate resources away from it under problemistic search.
A luminaire family with its own page fits the firm’s core range and brand, and with no sign of distress the firm likely has enough slack to retain it unless performance has clearly disappointed.
